messages.subject: Re: sequenza on hg38?
messages.body_plain:
Hi again Francesco!

I am back to running some Sequenza on hg38 again, and it seems there is an issue with the modified copynumber package. :/
in sequenza.extract, I get this error for each chromosome (GC information seems to go through properly).

Processing chr1:
Error in get0(oNam, envir = ns) :
  lazy-load database '/stornext/HPCScratch/home/flensburg.c/software/R/libs/copynumber/R/copynumber.rdb' is corrupt

I reinstalled the copynumber package, but the same error. I see that the github hasn't been touched for 3 years, but maybe some changes to R (this is version 3.6.0) or sequenza (3.0.0) has affected things?
Any ideas? Or are there now other ways to run Sequenza on hg38?

cheers,
/Christoffer

On Thursday, November 23, 2017 at 8:28:46 AM UTC+11, Francesco Favero wrote:

> Hi Christoffer,
>
> sequenza per-se doesn’t really deal with genome build, the problem is in the copynumber package used for the segmentation.
>
> here you can find how to use a modified version of copynumber to enable hg38, or any other genome build:

>
> https://github.com/aroneklund/copynumber
>
> Cheers
>
> Francesco
>

> > On 22 Nov 2017, at 06.02, Christoffer Flensburg <christoffe...@gmail.com> wrote:
> >

> > Hey all,
> >
> > Does sequenza support hg38? The error message "Error : assembly must be one of hg19, hg18, hg17 or hg16" seems to indicate that it doesn't.
> >
> > cheers,
> > /Christoffer
